# Sample Incubation Periods

Draws n samples from a lognormal distribution representing incubation
periods.

## Usage

``` r
inc.period.samp(n, meanlog = 1.63, sdlog = 0.5)
```

## Arguments

- n:

  Integer. Number of samples to draw.

- meanlog:

  Numeric. Mean of the distribution on the log scale. Default is 1.63
  (COVID-19 estimate, ~5.1 day median).

- sdlog:

  Numeric. Standard deviation of the distribution on the log scale.
  Default is 0.5 (COVID-19 estimate).

## Value

Numeric vector of length n containing incubation periods in days.

## Details

The default parameters are fitted to COVID-19 data. For other diseases,
supply appropriate lognormal parameters:

- Influenza: meanlog ≈ 0.34, sdlog ≈ 0.42 (~1.4 day median)

- SARS: meanlog ≈ 1.39, sdlog ≈ 0.51 (~4 day median)

- MERS: meanlog ≈ 1.61, sdlog ≈ 0.46 (~5 day median)

inc.period.samp(100)
